:::: {#hero-heading}

**Deliverable 4** of the BiodivPond pilot is a curated dataset with harmonised, quality-checked biodiversity records from the core ponds sampled by the active contributors, including both eDNA and acoustic data as well as metadata on habitat conditions and pressures.

This page is the entry point to that dataset. It will gradually grow to hold the map of the sampled pondscapes, an overview of the sampled sites, a summary of the data, and links to the published GBIF datasets and to the accompanying report.

## Sites sampled

A total of **60 core pond sites** were surveyed during the 2026 sampling season. All of them were sampled for environmental DNA (eDNA), and most were additionally covered by standardised traditional sampling and by passive acoustic monitoring (PAM).

### Pondscapes sampled
The core ponds are grouped into pondscapes distributed across the pilot partner countries. Each marker on the map shows a pondscape in which core ponds were sampled during the 2026 season.
